text:
Maria: seeing short intermittent packet drops between GPU nodes in r12-east-2 this morning. model-serving p99s spike and some gRPC errors. windows are brief, ~30-90s, not constant.

Zach: repro window? which nodes?

Maria: started 2026-03-12 08:10 UTC. nodes: gpu-r12-az1-03, gpu-r12-az1-04, gpu-r12-az1-07. symptoms only on geneve overlay—host nic counters look normal. happens during heavy sharded checkpoint sends.

Kai: MTU mismatch possibility? tunnel MTU set consistently?

Maria: verified geneve mtu=1400 on veths, host MTU 9000. did quick ping stress: 
```
# ping -s 1400 -i 0.02 -c 200 10.10.7.12
--- 10.10.7.12 ping statistics ---
200 packets transmitted, 197 received, 1.5% packet loss, time 4.0s
rtt min/avg/max/mdev = 0.53/1.24/12.8/0.98 ms
```

DevOps-Jen: 1.5% is significant. iperf3 while checkpointing?

Maria: iperf3 during the burst: 
```
[ ID] Interval           Transfer     Bandwidth
[  5]   0.00-10.00 sec  8.42 GBytes  7.23 Gbits/sec  (loss: ~1.2%)
```

Kai: NIC offload + fragmentation interaction could explain it. Which driver? ethtool -i output?

Maria: Mellanox mlx5, driver 5.14. Found these in dmesg near incident: 
```
mlx5_core 0000:65:00.0: pcie err severity corrected
netdev: mlx5: tx timeout on mlx5_core 0000:65:00.0
```

Zach: Any recent kernel/firmware change in that rack?

Maria: yes, kernel bumped to 6.6-rc in last release candidate rollout Friday. We rolled back two nodes for quick test and the rollback node stopped exhibiting the drops for the same workload.

Kai: strong signal: kernel+mlx5 offload regression. Quick mitigation: disable TSO/GSO/GRO on the host and see if drops disappear. Run: 
```
sudo ethtool -K eth0 tso off gso off gro off
```

DevOps-Jen: applying playbook patch to toggle offloads on the three suspects now, will run 30m soak.

oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Paging Maria (oncall) — detected 5% request error spike for model-service in r12-east-2

Maria: after disabling offloads on canary nodes, packet loss went from ~1.5% to ~0.1% under the same checkpoint workload. p99s returned to baseline.

Zach: mitigation plan: 1) fleet toggle offloads for r12-east-2, 2) pin kernel to previous release for GPU pool nodes until vendor/driver fix, 3) consider tx-queue/qdisc tweaks (txqueuelen, fq_codel adjustments) as precaution.

Kai: also add a small overlay probe that periodically sends MTU-sized packets and reports loss to Prometheus so we detect regressions earlier. I'll own vendor follow-up.

Maria: opening INFRA-3245 with logs, ping/iperf output, dmesg, and rollback evidence. Will schedule controlled canary kernel roll tomorrow and coordinate with Mellanox support. Action items: (a) fleet offload toggle, (b) kernel/vendor follow-up, (c) overlay MTU audit across regions, (d) active overlay-loss probe. Assigning Kai + DevOps-Jen.

DevOps-Jen: rolled config to remaining az1 nodes; 28m update: canary with offloads off => no measurable drops, app p99 stable. Rolling to rest of az1 now.

Zach: long-term we should maintain a kernel/driver compatibility matrix for our GPU fleets and gate kernel bumps on a quick overlay soak test. Also consider adding fragmentation guardrails in the agent to prevent large single-packet pushes when tunnel MTU shrinks.

Kai: noted. I'll follow up with vendor and paste any FW/driver patches into INFRA-3245. thanks all :thumbsup:
